cr_data.provenance: (An American Place, New York, NY); Philip J. Wickser, Buffalo, New York, 1937; Descended in family (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "No. 15 in 1931 An American Place exhibition. Painted 1930. Sold to Mr. Philip J. Wickser." Inscription in museum files: "Ranch church – Grey Sky 1930" (unidentified hand, backing board, pencil). Exhibited in 1931, reworked thereafter, and exhibited again in 1931–32. Pictured in 1931 and 1931–32 New York (An American Place) Stieglitz installation photographs, see Appendix III, figures 48, 49. See cat. nos. 1843, 1845, 1871, 1872. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
